context.title: Adaptive PLC fault investigation (drive feedback and D1 limits)

report.claimBoundary: Wonder-directed M8 campaign through the runtime owner's verified isolated adapter. Scope-limited experiment evidence; no certified controller coverage. HMI frames remain separate.

plan.objective: Execute the evidence-dependent D1 contradictory-limits follow-up and finish Stopped fault-free with no active item/pending completion.

experiments.objective: Inject fault.setDriveFeedbackFailure while attempting a carton run; observe whether PLC detects drive-start fault, removes motor command/feeds, and makes no false completion.

From drive-feedback fault evidence (:2016 Faulted/Code12, motor off), test whether D1 contradictory home+extended feedback in Auto produces a distinct PLC fault/indication with no false divert completion.
Inject fault.setDriveFeedbackFailure while attempting a carton run; observe whether PLC detects drive-start fault, removes motor command/feeds, and makes no false completion.

From drive-feedback fault evidence (:2016 Faulted/Code12, motor off), test whether D1 contradictory home+extended feedback in Auto produces a distinct PLC fault/indication with no false divert completion.

findings.title: Drive feedback failure faulted PLC with motor command removed and no completion; clear+Reset returned Stopped without restart
findings.inference: PLC outputs showed Faulted/FaultCode 12 with motor command removed and no pending completion during injected drive-feedback failure; after clearing the fault and a distinct Reset, outputs showed Stopped/FaultCode 0 with motor command still false, i.e. no auto-restart in the observed window.
assumptions: FaultCode 12 text is taken as PLC-reported string, not inferred from injected truth
findings.uncertainty: Exact drive-feedback detection deadline was not measured from a timestamped fault-onset PLC-output pair in the cited claims; CountExitA=1 is the observed value, baseline comparison is not claimed beyond cited pairs.

findings.title: D1 contradictory limits faulted PLC with distinct code, motor off and no completion; clear+Reset returned Stopped without restart
findings.inference: In contrast to drive-feedback FaultCode 12 at :2016 in the prior experiment, PLC outputs for the D1 contradictory-limits condition showed a distinct Faulted/FaultCode 21 with motor and D1 commands false and no pending completion; after clearing and a distinct Reset, outputs showed Stopped/FaultCode 0 with motor command still false.
assumptions: FaultCode 21 text is taken as PLC-reported string, not inferred from injected truth
findings.uncertainty: No carton was introduced in this follow-up, so divert-timing or misroute behavior under an active A assignment was not tested; detection deadline not claimed.

finalization.summary: Completed EXP-FAULT-DRIVEFB-01: PLC output :2016 showed Faulted, FaultCode 12 'Motor running feedback lost', Motor_RunCmd=false, CompletionPending=false; after fault clearance and distinct Reset, :3510 showed Stopped, FaultCode 0, Motor_RunCmd=false, ItemActive=false, CompletionPending=false. Then evidence-dependent follow-up EXP-ADAPT-D1CONTRA-02: PLC output :10359 showed Faulted, FaultCode 21 'D1 contradictory limits', Motor_RunCmd=false, D1_ExtendCmd=false, CompletionPending=false; after clearance and Reset, :11530 showed Stopped, FaultCode 0, Motor_RunCmd=false, ItemActive=false, CompletionPending=false, OfferPending=false. Findings FIND-DRIVEFB-01 and FIND-D1CONTRA-02 recorded with injected truth refs kept separate. No HMI operation was claimed.

facts.label: Claims traced to original child/transport records
Prior normal operation
facts.value: Historical normal-sort proof is labelled separately in the packet; it was not repeated in this campaign.

facts.label: Follow-up novelty
facts.value: The initial plan contained only drive-feedback failure. After observing fault12 and clean recovery, Muse proposed a distinct D1-limit contradiction test, explicitly generalizing the observed feedback-inconsistency response. Its cited current observations predate the proposal. This is a modest evidence-dependent extension, not discovery of an unknown fault.

facts.label: Execution
facts.value: Start, contradictory-limit injection, clear and Reset all executed in the newly active follow-up; native receipts and original child observations support both distinct fault21 and recovery. No human intervention occurred during the campaign.

limitations: The first proposed same-turn follow-up actions were refused before activation; observation waits timed out. Muse corrected this in the next turn. Those attempts remain in the evidence.
No carton was introduced for the D1 follow-up; misrouting and divert timing were not tested.
The first fault was running-feedback loss (12), not the startup-feedback deadline. Detection deadlines are not established.
The world retains one stationary virtual carton while the PLC has no tracked item. No world cleanup is represented as physical travel.
The new confirmed-PLC-rejection handling passed offline tests but was not exercised by a PLC rejection in this successful run.
Muse HMI operation remains a later checkpoint; these were semantic engine/controller tools.
